properties.title: Sunken Russian Vessel, SW of St Lawrence Isl, Alaska
properties.content: Notified by Sector Anchorage morning of 7-November 2012 of oiled birds and seal found by subsistence hunters in Savonga and Gamble on St Lawrence Isl.   Traced to sunken Russian vessel at 61° 49'N, 176° 55'W, considerably in Russian waters.  Juneau District CG office is assisting with Russian contacts.  Fuel is some kind of diesel, unknown quantity.  USFWS has been notified.   USCG is attempting to gather more information and considering asking NOAA to back-track trajectories.

properties.title: SMI 572 Collision, Bayou Perot, Lafitte, LA
properties.content: On 12MAR, USCG Sector New Orleans contacted NOAA SSC in regards to a tug/barge collision with a natural gas pipeline which has resulted in a 100 ft tall fire and four injuries, one severe. The incident occurred in Bayou Perot outside Lafitte, LA. The barge contained 2215 bbl crude oil and the tug contained 1000 gl diesel. The tug and barge are currently on fire. USCG is requesting a trajectory to support pollution response operations as oil has already been sighted on the water.

properties.title: F/V GEMINI, Swinomish Channel, WA
properties.content: At approximately 1200 Pacfic time September 24, 2012 NOAA SSC was notified by USCG Sector Puget Sound of the sunk fishing vessel GEMINI under the Twin Bridges in the Swinomish channel in Washington. It is unknown why the vessel sunk. The vessel is leaking diesel, although it is unknown how much diesel leaked and how much is left on board. The maximum capacity of the vessel is 750 gallons of diesel and 100 gallons of hydraulic fuel. The vessel is now contained in boom and dive operations are occuring on the afternoon of Sept. 25. NOAA ERD provided trajectory and weather information for the situation.
